bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
echo NOTIFICATION_WORKER_ENV_BEGIN
if docker inspect --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 | grep '^GAYBBS_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_ENABLED='; then :; else echo GAYBBS_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_ENABLED=UNSET; fi
echo NOTIFICATION_DB_BEGIN
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "SELECT 'gate:'||feature||':'||enabled||':ci='||(length(trim(coalesce(ci_evidence,'')))>0)||':runtime='||(length(trim(coalesce(gserver_runtime_evidence,'')))>0)||':e2e='||(length(trim(coalesce(telegram_e2e_evidence,'')))>0)||':approval='||(approved_by IS NOT NULL) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='announcement'; SELECT 'notifications:'||state||':'||count(*) FROM announcement_notifications GROUP BY state ORDER BY state; SELECT 'applications:'||status||':'||count(*) FROM announcement_applications GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;"
